entry.question: Are you family of {name}? We can guide you through filing a claim. We need to verify it's you.
shell.saved: Saved. You can return anytime — there's no rush.
otp.title: Let's verify it's you
otp.help: We've sent a one-time code to the nominee's phone {mobile} — not this phone. Please enter it below.
otp.no_nominee: We couldn't reach a nominee's phone. Please call us and we'll help you file.
otp.error_invalid: That code didn't work. Please check it and try again, or call us for help.
otp.error_rate_limit: Please wait a little before requesting another code.
relationship.title: Your relationship to {name}
relationship.help: This helps us guide the next steps. Take your time.
relationship.error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again, or call us — we'll help.
document.title: The death certificate
document.help: You can upload it now, or save and upload it within 7 days. There's no rush.
document.saved: Saved. You can return to upload anytime within 7 days.
document.uploaded: Document uploaded. We'll review it — there's nothing more you need to do.
document.upload_failed: The upload didn't go through. You can try again, or upload later — there's no rush.
document.permission_needed: Camera access is needed to take a photo. You can choose a PDF instead.
nominee.title: Nominee details
nominee.help: Please check these details. If anything looks wrong, call us — we'll help correct it.
nominee.name: Name
nominee.empty: No nominee details are on file yet. Please call us — we'll help.
nominee.load_error: We couldn't load these details right now. Please call us — we'll help.
nominee.bank.title: Bank accounts for the support amount
nominee.bank.help: Please add two bank accounts. If the first can't receive the amount, we'll use the second — so nothing is held up.
nominee.bank.holder_english: Please write the name in English, as it appears on the bank account.
nominee.bank.note_help: If the name on the bank account is written a little differently — an initial, a married name, or the bank's short form — you can explain it here.
nominee.bank.correction_needed: Please check the bank details below — they need correcting before the claim can go ahead. Your claim is still open.
nominee.bank.correction_needed_staff: The bank details on this claim need correcting. The District Admin will contact your family, take the corrected details and send the claim back up. Your claim is still open and has not been refused.
nominee.bank.being_checked: Your claim is still open — we are checking the bank details
nominee.bank.ifsc_error: We couldn't recognize that IFSC — please check it and try again.
nominee.bank.vpa_help: You can add a UPI ID. It lets members send this account their support through the app.
nominee.bank.vpa_invalid: That doesn't look like a UPI ID. It should look like name@bank.
nominee.bank.status_unavailable: We couldn't check the bank details on this claim just now. Please try again in a little while, or call us — we'll help.
nominee.bank.locked: Your bank details are with the Trust now. To change them, please call us — we'll help.
nominee.bank.error: We couldn't save these details right now. Please check them, or call us — we'll help.
nominee.bank.incomplete: Please fill in both accounts — the holder's name, account number, and a valid IFSC.
nominee.bank.existing_on_file: Bank details are already on file ({banks}). Saving below will replace both accounts.
ack.title: We're with you
ack.body: Thank you. Verification usually takes 2–3 weeks, and a field worker will visit. We'll keep you updated — there's nothing more you need to do right now.
readback.identity.title: Identity read-back — confirm before filing
readback.identity.script: I'd like to confirm a few details before we file the claim. Am I right that this is for {name}? Please confirm the name is correct.
readback.nominee.title: Nominee summary read-back — advisory only
readback.nominee.script: For our records, {name} has {count} registered nominee(s). This is only to help — it does not affect filing the claim.
dpdpa.title: Consent for this claim
dpdpa.help: Please read and agree below so we can go ahead with this claim.
dpdpa.processing: I consent to the Trust processing the deceased member’s, my, and the nominees’ personal information as needed to verify and settle this claim.
dpdpa.processing_required_hint: Please agree to the first item so we can process this claim.
dpdpa.error: We couldn't save your choice right now. Please try again, or call us — we'll help.
dpdpa.error_missing_claim: We couldn't find this claim to record your consent. Please call us — we'll help you continue.
shepherd.title: Your point of contact
shepherd.body: A real person is looking after your claim. You can reach them any time.
shepherd.not_assigned: We'll assign a named point of contact once we begin verifying the claim. There's nothing you need to do.
shepherd.contact_being_arranged: We're arranging a way for you to reach them. In the meantime, you can always call us.
shepherd.offline: Showing your saved contact details — you appear to be offline.
shepherd.error: We couldn't load your point of contact just now. Please try again, or call us — we'll help.
appeal.eligible: This claim was not approved. If you believe that was a mistake, you can ask us to look at it again.
appeal.no_deadline: There's no time limit — you can ask for a review whenever you're ready.
appeal.status_stage1: A reviewer is taking a fresh look at your claim.
appeal.status_stage2: A panel of trustees is reviewing your claim together.
appeal.status_stage3: A trustee is making the final decision on your claim.
appeal.reversed: Good news — the earlier decision was overturned and your claim is being taken forward again.
appeal.upheld_final: After a full review, the earlier decision stands. We're sorry this isn't the outcome you hoped for.
appeal.external_remedy: Completing this review does not affect your right to seek help outside — you may still approach a consumer commission or civil court if you wish.
certificate.replacement_title: A new death certificate is needed
certificate.replacement_body: The death certificate we received does not show a clear date of death. Please upload one that does.
certificate.replacement_body_future: The date of death on the certificate we received is a future date. Please upload a certificate that shows the correct date of death.
certificate.not_refused: Your claim is still open and has not been refused.
certificate.missing_body: We have not received the death certificate yet. Please upload it. Your claim is still open.
certificate.replacement_helpline: If you can't upload it, call the helpline and we will help you.
certificate.awaiting_review: We have the death certificate and will review it. There's nothing more you need to do.
certificate.accepted: The death certificate has been accepted.
contact.title: How we can reach the family
contact.help: If a bank detail on this claim ever needs correcting, we will contact these people by text message or by post. Please give a postal address for each nominee.
contact.address_help: House, street, village or town, district and PIN code.
contact.address_required: Please give a postal address for this nominee.
contact.no_nominees: No nominee was declared, so we only need the claimant's details.
contact.claimant_question: Is the person making this claim one of the nominees?
contact.claimant_required: Please tell us who is making this claim.
contact.claimant_details_required: Please give the claimant's name, mobile number and postal address.
contact.relationship_question: The claimant is nominee {rank}'s … (for example: the claimant is their son)
contact.relationship_required: Please choose how the claimant is related to this nominee.
contact.agreement: I agree that the Trust may contact the nominees and the claimant named here, by text message and by post, about this claim.
contact.agreement_required: Please agree, so that we can contact these people about this claim.
contact.incomplete: Some details are missing. Please check the marked fields.
contact.error: We couldn't save these details right now. Please try again, or call us — we'll help.
contact.not_writable: These details can't be changed in the app any more. Please call the helpline — we'll help.
$comment.correction_chase: Story 6.19b: the Hindi of correction_sms.reminder, correction_sms.closure_notice and nominee.bank.being_checked was agent-authored and HUMAN-REVIEWED by BigDev on 2026-10-01 (accepted as written) — launch-gate Row 20 closed. The SMS keys must match the registered DLT content byte for byte: any later change to them must be re-registered.
correction_sms.reminder: Claim {reference}: the bank details on your family's claim need correcting. Please call the helpline on {helpline}, or the District Admin will contact you. Your claim is still open.
correction_sms.closure_notice: Claim {reference}: this claim was closed because no correction of the bank details was received. This closure cannot be appealed. A new claim may be filed through the helpline on {helpline} or the District Admin.
$comment.certificate_reminder: Story 6.19d: certificate_sms.reminder is the replacement-certificate reminder (`2026-10-03-276` CR7). One wording for both causes (a certificate not accepted, or none received) — it names no reason and no deadline. The Hindi was agent-authored and is NOT YET HUMAN-REVIEWED — go-live gate Row 21 (certificate-reminder-hindi-human-review). The SMS key must match the registered DLT content byte for byte: any later change must be re-registered.
certificate_sms.reminder: Claim {reference}: your family's claim still needs a death certificate that clearly shows the date of death. Please send it in the app, or call the helpline on {helpline}. Your claim is still open.
$comment.refile: Story 6.19c: the Hindi of refile.* was agent-authored and HUMAN-REVIEWED by BigDev on 2026-10-01 (accepted as written).
refile.title: This claim was closed
refile.body: This claim was closed because the corrected bank details did not reach us. A new claim can be filed with the helpline's help. Please call us and we will guide you through it.
$comment.closed: Story 6.24a (`2026-10-07-292` RF12, RF14 (b)): closed.* is the member app's calm screen for a claim CLOSED because another claim for the same death won its appeal — it states only that the claim is closed and to call the helpline (no reason, no other claim, no name). appeal_helpline.* is the line the helpline operator reads to the family about a refusal's appeal date (`2026-10-07-291` Q1 A). The Hindi was agent-authored and is NOT YET HUMAN-REVIEWED.
closed.title: This claim has been closed
closed.body: This claim has been closed. Please call the helpline.
appeal_helpline.ended: The time to appeal ended on {date}.
